a: Uvayit name, af al pi sheen gavoah asara, kevan dikvia — uhela hu, dela gara mikkinofot.
Lishshana acharina amri la, amar rav yehuda amar shemuel: muttar lishan bechillat chatanim bassukka lefi sheen lah gag, af al pi sheggevoha asara.
Metivi: hayyashen bechilla bassukka — lo yatza yede chovato! hacha bemay askinan — besheyyesh lah gag.

Ta shema: naklitin shenayim, vekinofot arbaa, peras al gabbe kinofot — pesula, al gabbe naklitin — keshera, uvilvad shello yehu naklitin gevohin min hammitta asara tefachim. ha gevohin min hammitta asara — pesula, af al pi sheen lah gag!
Shane naklitin, dikvii. i kevii, leheve kekinofot! legabbay kinofot — la kevii, legabbe chilla — kevii.

Daresh rabba bar rav huna: muttar lishan bechilla, af al pi sheyyesh lah gag, af al pi sheggevoha asara. keman — kerabbi yehuda, deamar: la ate ohel aray umevattel ohel keva. ditnan, amar rabbi yehuda: nohagin hayinu lishan tachat hammitta bifne hazzekenim.
Velema halacha kerabbi yehuda!

I amar halacha kerabbi yehuda, hava amena: hane mille mitta, dilgabbah asuya, aval killa, diltochah asuya — ema la, ka mashma lan tama derabbi yehuda dela ate ohel aray umevattel ohel kava, la shena mitta vela shena killa.
Mishna hidla aleha et haggefen veet haddallaat veet hakkisos vesikkech al gabbah — pesula. veim haya sikkuch harebe mehen, o shekketzatzan — keshera.
Ze hakkelal: kol shehu mekabbel tumea veen giddulo min haaretz — en mesakkechin bo. vechol davar sheeno mekabbel tumea vegiddulo min haaretz — mesakkechin bo.
Gemara yatev rav yosef kammeh derav huna, veyatev vekaamar: o shekketzatzan keshera, veamar rav: tzarich lenanea.

Amar leh rav huna: ha shemuel amra. ahderinhu rav yosef leappeh vaamar leh: attu mi kaamena lach dela amra shemuel? amra rav, veamra shemuel! amar leh rav huna: hachi kaamena lach dishmuel amra vela rav, derav achshore machshar. ki ha derav amram chasida rema techelta lefarzuma deinashe beteh. telaan, velo pasak rashe chutin shellahen.
Ata lekammeh derav chiyyay bar ashe, amar leh: hachi amar rav: mefassekan vehen kesherin. alma: pesikatan zo hi asiyyaytan. hacha name: ketzitzatan zo hi asiyyaytan.

Vesavar shemuel la amrinan pesikatan zo hi asiyyaytan? veha tane shemuel mishshum rabbi chiyyay: hetil lishne keranot bevat achat, veachar kach pasak rashe chutin shellahen — kesherin. may lav — shekkosher veachar kach posek! lo, shepposek veachar kach kosher.
Posek veachar kach kosher may lememra! mahu detema:
b: Baenan kanaf bishat petil — velekka, ka mashma lan.

Metivi: telaan velo pasak rashe chutin shellahen — pesulin. may lav: pesulin leolam, uteyuveta derav? amar lecha rav: may pesulin — pesulin ad sheyyippasku. ushemuel amar: pesulin leolam. vechen amar levi: pesulin leolam. vechen amar rav matna amar shemuel: pesulin leolam.
Ikka deamri, amar rav matna: bedidi hava ovada, vaatay lekammeh demar shemuel, vaamar li: pesulin leolam.

Metivi: telaan, veachar kach pasak rashe chutin shellahen pesulin. veod tanya gabbe sukka: "taase" — velo min heasuy. mikkan amru: hidla aleha et haggefen veet haddallaat veet hakkisos vesikkech al gabban — pesula.

Hechi dame? illema beshello ketzatzan, may irya mishshum "taase" — velo min heasuy? tippok leh dimchubbarin ninhu! ella beshekketzatzan, vekatane pesula, ushema minna dela amrinan ketzitzatan zo hi asiyyaytan, uteyuveta derav!
Amar lecha rav: hacha bemay askinan — deshalfinhu shallofe, dela minnachra asiyya didhu. mikkol makom, telaan veachar kach pasak, kashya lerav! kashya.
Lema ketannae. avar velikketan — pasul, divre rabbi shimon bar yehotzadak. vachachamim machshirin.
Savruha dechulle alma lulav tzarich eged, veyalfinan lulav missukka. dichtiv gabbe sukka: "taase" — velo min heasuy.

May lav, beha ka mippalgi: deman demachshayr savar: amrinan gabbe sukka ketzitzatan zo hi asiyyaytan, vegabbe lulav name amrinan lekitatan zo hi asiyyaytan. uman defasel savar: la amrinan gabbe sukka ketzitzatan zo hi asiyyaytan, vegabbe lulav name la amrinan lekitatan zo hi asiyyaytan!

La, dechulle alma la amrinan gabbe sukka ketzitzatan zo hi asiyyaytan, vehacha bemelaf lulav missukka kamippalgi. man demachshar savar: la yalfinan lulav missukka, uman defasel savar: yalfinan lulav missukka.

Vei baet ema: i sevira lan delulav tzarich eged, kulle alma la peligi deyalfinan lulav missukka. vehacha beha kamippalgi, mar savar: tzarich eged, umar savar: en tzarich eged. uviflugeta dehane tannae, detanya: lulav, ben agud ben sheeno agud — kasher, rabbi yehuda omer: agud — kasher, sheeno agud — pasul.

May tameh derabbi yehuda? yalef "lekicha" "lekicha" meaguddat ezov. ketiv hatam: "ulekachtem aguddat ezov", uchetiv hacha: "ulekachtem lachem bayyom harishon". ma lehallan baagudda, af kan name baagudda. verabbanan: "lekicha" millekicha" la yalfinan.

Keman azla ha detanya: lulav mitzva leogdo, veim lo agado — kasher. i rabbi yehuda, ki lo agado ammay kasher? i rabbanan, ammay mitzva? leolam rabbanan hi, umishshum shenneemar: "ze eli veanvehu" — hitnae lefanav bemitzvot.

Ze hakkelal: kol davar shemmekabbel tumea kulei. mena hane mille? amar resh lakish, amar kera: "veed yaale min haaretz". ma ed — davar sheeno mekabbel tumea vegiddulo min haaretz, af sukka — davar sheen mekabbel tumea vegiddulo min haaretz.

Hanicha leman deamar anne chavod hayu. ella leman deamar sukkot mammash asu lahem, may ikka lememar? detanya: "ki vassukkot hoshavti et bene yisrael", anne chavod hayu, divre rabbi eliezer. rabbi akiva omer: sukkot mammash asu lahem. hanicha lerabbi eliezer, ella lerabbi akiva may ikka lememar?

Ki ata rav dimi amar rabbi yochanan, amar kera: "chag hassukkot taase lecha", makkish sukka lachagiga. ma chagiga — davar sheeno mekabbel tumea vegiddulo min haaretz, af sukka — davar sheeno mekabbel tumea vegiddulo min haaretz.

a: I: ma chagiga baale chayyim, af sukka name baale chayyim!
Ki ata ravin amar rabbi yochanan, amar kera: "beospecha miggornecha umiyyikvecha", bifsolet goren vayekev hakkatuv medabber.
Veema goren atzmo vayekev atzmo! amar rabbi zera: "yekev" ketiv kan, vei efshar lesakkech bo.
Matkef la rabbi yirmeya: veema yayin karush habba missenir shehu dome leiggule devela! amar rabbi zera: ha milleta hava bidan, vaata rabbi yirmeya usheda bay narga.
Rav ashe amar: "miggornecha" velo goren atzmo, "miyyikvecha" velo yekev atzmo.
Rav chisda amar mehacha: "tzeu hahar vehaviu ale zayit vaale etz shemen vaale hadas vaale temarim vaale etz avot".
Hayeynu "hadas", hayeynu "etz avot"! amar rav chisda: hadas shote — lesukka, veetz avot — lelulav.
Mishna chavile kash vachavile etzim vachavile zeradin — en mesakkechin bahen. vechullan shehittiran — kesherot. vechullan kesherot lidfanot.
Gemara amar rabbi yaakov: shemait minneh derabbi yochanan tarte: chada — ha, veiddach — hachotet baggadish laasot lo sukka — enah sukka.
Chada: mishshum gezerat otzar. vachada mishshum: "taase", velo min heasuy. vela yadana he minnayyhu mishshum otzar vehe minnayyhu mishshum taase velo min heasuy.

Amar rabbi yirmeya: nichze anan, deamar rabbi chiyyay bar abba amar rabbi yochanan: mippene ma amru chavile kash vachavile etzim vachavile zeradin en mesakkechin bahen? peamim sheadam ba min hassade baerev vachavilato al ketefo, umaalah umannichah al gabbe sukkato kede leyabbeshah, venimlach aleha lesikkuch, vehattora amra: "taase", velo min heasuy. middeha mishshum gezerat otzar, ha mishshum "taase" velo min heasuy.
Verabbi yaakov? hach derabbi chiyyay bar abba la shemia leh.

Amar rav ashe: attu chavile kash vachavile etzim mishshum gezerat otzar ikka, mishshum "taase" velo min heasuy lekka? vehachotet begadish, mishshum "taase" velo min heasuy ikka, mishshum gezerat otzar lekka?
Verabbi yochanan amar lach, hacha dekatane: "en mesakkechin bahen", lechattechilla hu
b: Deen mesakkechin mishshum gezerat otzar, ha deorayyta shappir dame. hatam dekatane "enah sukka" afillu diavad — middeorayyta name enah sukka.
Amar rav yehuda amar rav: sikkechah bechitztzin zecharim — keshera. binkevot — pesula.
Zecharim keshera, peshita! mahu detema: nigzor zecharim attu nekevot, ka mashma lan.
(Amar mar:) binkevot pesula, peshita! mahu detema: bet kibbul heasuy lemalloot la shemeh kibbul, kamashma lan.
Amar rabba bar bar chana amar rabbi yochanan: sikkechah baanitze fishtan — pesula. behutzene fishtan — keshera. vehushene fishtan, eni yodea mahu.
Vehushene atzman eni yodea. ma nafshach: i deyik vela nefitz — hushene kare leh, aval tere vela deyik — hutzene kare leh, o dilma: tere vela deyik name hushene kare leh.
Amar rav yehuda: hane shushe ushevotzre — mesakkechin behu. abbaye amar: beshushe mesakkechin, bishvotzre la mesakkechin. may tama, kevan

a: Desare rechayyhu — shavek lehu venafek.
Amar rav chanan bar rava: hane hizme vehige mesakkechin behu. abbaye amar: behizme — mesakkechinan, behige — la mesakkechinan. may tama — kevan denatri tarfayyhu, shavek la venafek.
Amar rav giddel amar rav: hay appakuta dedikla mesakkechin behu. af al gav daagidi, eged bide shamayim la shemeh eged. af al gav dahadar aged lehu, eged bechad la shemeh eged.
Amar rav chisda amar ravina bar shela: hane dukere dekane mesakkechin behu. af al gav daagidi ninhu — eged bide shamayim la shemeh eged. af al gav dahadar aged lehu — eged bechad la shemeh eged.
Tanya name hachi: kanim vedukeranin mesakkechin bahen. kanim peshita! ema: kanim shel dukeranin mesakkechin bahen.
Veamar rav chisda amar ravina bar shela: hane meraryata deagma — adam yotze bahen yede chovato bappesach.
Metivi: ezov, velo ezov yon, velo ezov kocholi, velo ezov midbari, velo ezov romi, velo ezov sheyyesh lo shem levavy.
Amar abbaye: kol shennishtanna shemo kodem mattan tora, uvata tora vehikpida alav — beyadua sheyyesh lo shem levavy. vehane lo nishtanna shemayyhu kodem mattan tora kelal.
Rava amar: hane — meraryata setama shemayyhu, vehay dekare lehu meraryata deagma — mishshum demishtechach beagma.

Amar rav chisda: eged bechad — la shemeh eged. shalosh — shemeh eged. shenayim — machloket rabbi yose verabbanan. ditnan: mitzvat ezov, shelosha kelachim uvahen shelosha givolin. rabbi yose omer: mitzvat ezov shelosha givolin, usheyarav shenayim, vegardummav kol shehu.
Ka salka datin middishyarav shenayim, techillato name shenayim, vehay dekatane shelosha — lemitzva. umidderabbi yose shelosha lemitzva, lerabbanan shelosha leakkev.

Vehatanya, rabbi yose omer: ezov techillato shenayim usheyarav echad pasul, veeno kasher ad sheyyehe techillato shelosha usheyarav shenayim! efoch: lerabbi yose shelosha leakkev, lerabbanan shelosha lemitzva.
Vehatanya: ezov techillato shenayim usheyarav echad — kasher, veeno pasul ad sheyyehe techillato usheyarav echad.
Sheyarav echad pasul? ha amrat sheyarav echad kasher!
b: Ella ema: ad shettehe techillato kishyarav echad.
Daresh marimar: hane issureyayta desura — mesakkechin behu. af al gav daagidan — leminyana bealma hu daagidan.
Amar rabbi abba: hane tzerife deurebane, kevan shehuttera rashe maadannim shellahen — kesherin. veha agidi mittattay! amar rav pappa: deshare lehu.
(Veamar) rav huna bereh derav yehoshua: afillu tema dela share lehu, kol eged sheeno asuy letaltelo — la shemeh eged.

Amar rabbi abba amar shemuel: yerakot sheamru chachamim adam yotze bahen yede chovato bappesach, meviin et hattumea, veen chotztzin bifne hattumea, ufoslin bassukka mishshum avir. may tama — kevan dilchi yavshi parchi venafli, keman deletanhu dame.
Veamar rabbi abba amar rav huna: habbotzer laggat — en lo yadot.
Verav menashsheya bar gadda amar rav huna: hakkotzer lischach — en lo yadot.

Man deamar kotzer, kol shekken botzer — dela nicha leh, dela nimtzeyeh lechamreh. man deamar botzer sheen lo yadot, aval kotzer yesh lo yadot — denicha leh delisakkech behu, ki hechi dela libbadderan.

Nema derav menashsheya bar gadda tannae hi? detanya: soche teenim uvahen teenim, parkilin uvahen anavim, kashshin uvahen shibbolim, machbedot uvahen temarim, kullan, im pesolet merubba al haochalin — keshera, veim lav — pesula. acherim omrim: ad sheyyehu kashshin merubbin al hayyadot veal haochalin.
May lav, beha ka mippalgi: demar savar yesh lahen yadot, umar savar en lahen yadot!

Lerabbi abba — vadday tannae hi. lerav menashsheya bar gadda mi lema tannae hi? amar lach rav menashsheya: dechulle alma savri hakkotzer lischach en lo yadot. vehacha bemay askinan — kegon shekkevtzatzan laachila, venimlach alehen lesikkuch.
I kevtzatzan laachila, may tamayyhu derabbanan? vechi tema kasavri rabbanan kevan denimlach alehen lesikkuch, batla leh machshavto. umi batla leh machshava behachi? vehatnan: kol hakkelim

a: Yordin lide tumea bemachshava, veen olin mittumeatan ella beshinnuy maase. maase motzi miyyad maase umiyyad machshava. machshava enah motzia lo miyyad maase velo miyyad machshava.

Vechi tema hane mille kelim dachashivi, aval yadot, diltzorech achila ninhu — bemachshava naase uvemachshava salka. vehatnan: kol yedot haochalin shebbesasan baggoren — tehorot (verabbi yose metamme).
Bishlama leman deamar "besasan" — hittir iggudan, shappir. ella leman deamar may "besasan" — besasan mammash, may ikka lememar?
Hacha name, shebbesasan mammash. i hachi, may tamayyhu daacherim? daamur kerabbi yose. ditnan: rabbi yose metamme.
Hay may?! bishlama hatam — tama derabbi yose chazya lechidrabbi shimon ben lakish. deamar rabbi shimon ben lakish: hoil ureuyot lehofchan beeter.
Ella hacha lemay chazya? chazya lechi satar leminkat lehu begilayyhu.
Gufa, kol yedot haochalin shebbesasan baggoren — tehorot, verabbi yose metamme. may "besasan"? rabbi yochanan amar: besasan mammash. rabbi (eliezer) omer: hittir agdan.

Bishlama lerabbi (eliezer), deamar "besasan" — hittir agdan, hayeynu dimtamme rabbi yose. ella lerabbi yochanan deamar besasan mammash, ammay metamme rabbi yose? amar rabbi shimon ben lakish: hoil ureuyot lehofchan beeter.

Amar rabbi (eliezer): lamma nimshela tefillatan shel tzaddikim keeter — lomar lach: ma eter ze mehappech et hattevua baggoren mimmakom lemakom, af tefillatan shel tzaddikim mehappechet dato shel hakkadosh baruch hu mimmiddat achzariyyut lemiddat rachamanut.
Mishna mesakkechin binsarim, divre rabbi yehuda, verabbi meir oser. natan aleha neser shehu rachav arbaa tefachim — keshera, uvilvad shello yishan tachtav.

Gemara amar rav: machloket binsarin sheyyesh bahen arbaa, derabbi meir it leh gezerat tikra, verabbi yehuda let leh gezerat tikra. aval binsarin sheen bahen arbaa — divre hakkol keshera. ushemuel amar: besheen bahen arbaa machaloket, aval yesh bahen arbaa — divre hakkol pesula.
En bahen arbaa, vaafillu pachot mishshelosha, ha kanim bealma ninhu?

Amar rav pappa, hachi kaamar: yesh bahen arbaa — divre hakkol pesula, pachot mishshelosha — divre hakkol keshera, may tama — kanim bealma ninhu. ki peligi, mishshelosha ad arbaa. mar savar: kevan deletanhu shiur makom, la gazrinan. umar savar: kevan denafki lehu mittorat lavud, gazrinan.

Tenan: natan aleha neser shehu rachav arbaa tefachim — keshera, uvilvad shello yishan tachtav. bishlama lishmuel deamar besheen bahen arbaa machloket, aval yesh bahen arbaa divre hakkol pesula, mishshum hachi la yishan tachtav. ella lerav deamar besheyyesh bahen arbaa machloket, aval en bahen arbaa divre hakkol keshera, lerabbi yehuda ammay lo yishan tachtav?
Mi savrat divre hakkol hi? sefa atan lerabbi meir.
Ta shema: shene sedinin mitztarfin.
b: Shene nesarin en mitztarfin. rabbi meir omer: af nesarin kisdinin.
Bishlama lishmuel deamar besheen bahen arbaa machloket, aval yesh bahen arbaa divre hakkol pesula, may "mitztarfin" — mitztarfin learbaa.

Ella lerav, deamar besheyyesh bahen arbaa machloket, aval en bahen arbaa divre hakkol keshera, hechi dame? i deit behu arbaa, lema lehu leitzterofe? i delet behu arbaa, ammay? veha kanim bealma ninhu?
Leolam deit behu arbaa, umay "mitztarfin" — mitztarfin learba ammot min hatztzad.
Lishshana acharina: bishlama lishmuel deamar besheen bahen arbaa machloket, aval yesh bahen arbaa divre hakkol pesula, may "mitztarfin" — mitztarfin learba ammot min hatztzad.

Ella lerav: bishlama lerabbi meir, may "mitztarfin" — mitztarfin learba ammot min hatztzad. ella lerabbi yehuda deamar afillu yesh bahen arbaa keshera, may "en mitztarfin"? kanim bealma ninhu! ayyeyde dekaamar rabbi meir "mitztarfin", amar rabbi yehuda "en mitztarfin".
Tanya kevoteh derav, tanya kevoteh dishmuel.
Tanya kevoteh derav: sikkechah binsarim shel erez sheen bahen arbaa — divre hakkol keshera. yesh bahen arbaa — rabbi meir posel verabbi yehuda machshir.
Amar rabbi yehuda: maase bishat hassakkana shehevenu nesarim shehayu bahen arbaa vesikkachnu al gabbe mirpeset, veyashavnu tachtehen! amru lo: mishsham reaya?! en sheat hassakkana reaya.

Tanya kevoteh dishmuel: sikkechah binsarim shel erez sheyyesh bahen arbaa — divre hakkol pesula. en bahen arbaa — rabbi meir posel verabbi yehuda machshir. umode rabbi meir sheim yesh ben neser leneser kimlo neser — shemmanniach pesal benehem, ucheshera. umode rabbi yehuda sheim natan aleha neser shehu rachav arbaa tefachim — keshera, veen yeshenim tachtav, vehayyashen tachtav — lo yatza yede chovato.
Ittemar: hafachan al tziddehen, rav huna amar: pesula, verav chisda verabba bar rav huna amri: keshera.
Ikkela rav nachman lesura, ul legabbeh rav chisda verabba bar rav huna. amri leh: hafachan al tziddehen, mahu? amar lehu: pesula, naasu keshappudin shel mattechet.
Amar lehu rav huna: la amari lechu emaru kevoti? amaru leh: umi amar lan mar tama vela kabbelynan minneh? amar lehu: umi beetu minnay tama vela amari lechu?

Lema mesayyay leh: enah machzeket kede rosho verubbo veshulechano, o shennifretza bah pirtza kede sheyyizdakker bah gedi bevat rosh, o shennatan aleha neser shehu rachav arbaa tefachim, af al pi shello hichnis letochah ella shelosha tefachim — pesula.

Hechi dame, (may) lav kegon shehafachan al tziddehem? la, hacha bemay askinan — kegon deannecha appumma dimtallalta, deayel telata legav veappek chad levar, dehave leh pesal hayyotze min hassukka, vechol pesal hayyotze min hassukka — niddon kassukka.

a: Mishna tikra sheen aleha maaziva, rabbi yehuda omer: bet shammay omrim: mefakpek, venotel achat mibbentayim. uvet hillel omrim: mefakpek, o notel achat mibbentayim. rabbi meir omer: notel achat mibbentayim, veeno mefakpek.

Gemara bishlama bet hillel, tamayyhu mishshum "taase" velo min heasuy. i mefakpek, aved leh maase. i notel achat mibbentayim, aved ba maase. ella bet shammay, may tamayyhu? i mishshum "taase" velo min heasuy — bachada saggi! i mishshum gezerat tikra — benotel achat mibbentayim saggi!
Leolam mishshum gezerat tikra, vehachi kaamri: af al pi shemmefakpek, i notel achat mibbentayim — in, i la — la.
I hachi, ema sefa: rabbi meir omer: notel achat mibbentayim, aval lo yefakpek — rabbi meir hayeynu bet shammay!
Hachi kaamar: lo nechleku bet shammay uvet hillel bedavar ze.
May ka mashma lan? derabbi meir it leh gezerat tikra, verabbi yehuda let leh gezerat tikra — veha ippeligu ba chada zimna! ditnan: mesakkechin binsarim, divre rabbi yehuda. verabbi meir oser.
Amar rabbi chiyyay bar abba amar rabbi yochanan: resha — binsarim meshuppin askinan, umishshum gezerat kelim nagu bah.
Ulerav yehuda amar rav, deamar: sikkechah bechitztzin zecharim — keshera. binkevot — pesula, vela gazar zecharim attu nekevot. hacha name la nigzar nesarim meshuppin attu kelim!
Ella al korchach resha peligi bigzerat tikra, vesefa peligi bigzerat tikra. veippeloge betarte zimne lema li?

Sefa rabbi yehuda (hi), deka amar leh lerabbi meir: ammay ka asrat binsarim — mishshum gezerat tikra? hay sevara levet shammay hu deit lehu, uvet hillel la gazri! veamar rabbi meir: lo nechleku bet shammay uvet hillel bedavar ze.

Hanicha lerav, deamar machloket besheyyesh bahen arbaa, derabbi meir it leh gezerat tikra verabbi yehuda let leh gezerat tikra. ella shemuel, deamar besheen bahen arbaa machloket, aval yesh bahen arbaa — divre hakkol pesula, sefa bemay peligi?
Bevayttole tikra ka mippalgi: mar savar batla behachi, umar savar behachi la batla.
Mishna hamekare sukkato beshappudin o baarukkot hammitta, im yesh revach benehen kemotan — keshera. hachotet begadish laasot lo sukka — enah sukka.
Gemara lema tehve teyuveta derav huna bereh derav yehoshua. deittemar: parutz keomed, rav pappa amar: muttar. verav huna bereh derav yehoshua amar: asur!
Amar lecha rav huna bereh derav yehoshua: may kemotan — benichnas veyotze.
b: Veha efshar letzamtzem! amar rabbi amme: bemaadif.
Rava amar: afillu tema besheen maadif, im hayu netunim sheti — notnan erev, erev — notnan sheti.
O baarukkot hammitta. lema mesayyay leh lerabbi amme bar tavyome, deamar rabbi amme bar tavyome: sikkechah bivlae chelim — pesula.
Kidamar rabbi chanan amar rabbi: baarukka ushete cheraayim, biktzara ushete cheraayim. hacha name: baarukka ushete cheraayim, biktzara ushete cheraayim.
Hecha ittemar derabbi chanan amar rabbi? aha ditnan:

a: Mitta metammet chavila umetaheret chavila, divre rabbi eliezer. vachachamim omrim: metammet evarim umetaheret evarim. may nihu? amar rabbi chanan amar rabbi: arukka ushete cheraayim, ketzara ushete cheraayim.
Lemay chazya? lemismechinhu aggudda ulemetav alayyhu umishde ashle.
Gufa, amar rabbi amme bar tavyome: sikkechah bivlae chelim pesula. may belae chelim? amar abbaye: matlaniyyot sheen bahem shalosh al shalosh, dela chazyayn lo laaniyyim velo laashirim.
Tanya kevoteh derabbi amme bar tavyome: machtzelet shel shifa veshel gemi, sheyareha, af al pi shennifchatu mikkeshiurah — en mesakkechin bahen.
Machtzelet hakkanim, gedola — mesakkechin bah, ketanna, — en mesakkechin bah. rabbi eliezer omer: af hi mekabbelet tumea, veen mesakkechin bah.
Hachotet begadish. amar rav huna: lo shanu ella sheen sham chalal tefach bemeshech shiva, aval yesh sham chalal tefach bemeshech shiva — hare zo sukka.
Tanya name hachi: hachotet begadish laasot lo sukka — hare zo sukka. vehaanan tenan enah sukka! ella lav, shema minna kidrav huna. shema minna.

Ikka derame lay mirme. tenan: hachotet begadish laasot lo sukka — enah sukka. veha tanya: hare zo sukka! amar rav huna, la kashya: kan besheyyesh sham chalal tefach bemeshech shiva, kan besheen sham chalal tefach bemeshech shiva.

Mishna hameshalshel defanot milmala lematta, im gavoah min haaretz shelosha tefachim — pesula. millematta lemala, im gavoah asara tefachim — keshera. rabbi yose omer: keshem shemmillematta lemala asara tefachim, kach milmala lematta asara tefachim.
Gemara bemay kamippalgi? mar savar mechitza teluya matteret, umar savar mechitza teluya enah matteret.
Tenan hatam: bor shebben shete chatzerot — en memallein mimmenna beshabbat ella im ken asa lah mechitza asara tefachim, ben milmala ben millematta, ben betoch ogno. rabban shimon ben gamliel omer:
b: Bet shammay omrim milmala, uvet hillel omrim millematta. amar rabbi yehuda: lo tehe mechitza gedola min hakkotel shebbenehen.
Amar rabba bar bar chana amar rabbi yochanan: rabbi yehuda beshitat rabbi yose amarah, deamar mechitza teluya matteret.
Vela hi, la rabbi yehuda savar la kerabbi yose, vela rabbi yose savar la kerabbi yehuda.
La rabbi yehuda savar la kerabbi yose: ad kan la kaamar rabbi yehuda hatam, ella beeruve chatzerot derabbanan. aval hacha, sukka deorayyta — la.
Vela rabbi yose savar la kerabbi yehuda: ad kan la kaamar rabbi yose hacha, ella besukka demitzvat ase. aval shabbat, deissur sekila — la.
Veim tomar: maase shennaasa betzippori, al pi mi naasa? lo al pi rabbi yose, ella al pi rabbi yishmael berabbi yose.
Umay maase — dechi ata rav dimi, amar: paam achat shachchu velo heviu sefer tora meerev shabbat, lemachar persu sedinin al gabbe haammudim, veheviu sefer tora vekaru bo.
Persu salka datach? mehechan hevium beshabbat! ella, matzu sedinin perusin al gabbe haammudim veheviu sefer tora vekaru bo.

Amar rav chisda amar avimi: machtzelet arbaa umashshehu — matteret besukka mishshum dofen. hechi aved? tale leh baemtza, pachot mishshelosha lematta ufachot mishshelosha lemala, vechol pachot mishshelosha kelavud dame.
Peshita? mahu detema: chad lavud amrinan, tere lavud la amrinan — ka mashma lan.
Metivi: machtzelet shiva umashshehu matteret besukka mishshum dofen. ki tanya hahi, besukka gedola. umay ka mashma lan — dimshalshelin defanot milmala lematta kerabbi yose.
Amar rabbi amme: pas arbaa umashshehu — mattir besukka mishshum dofen. umokem leh befachot mishshelosha tefachim samuch dofen, vechol pachot mishshelosha samuch laddofen kelavud dame.
May ka mashma lan? ha ka mashma lan — shiur meshech sukka ketanna shiva.

a: Mishna hirchik et hassikkuch min haddefanot shelosha tefachim — pesula.
Bayit shennifchat vesikkech al gabbav — im yesh min hakkotel lassikkuch arba ammot, pesula.
Vechen chatzer shehi mukkefet achsadra, sukka gedola shehikkifuha bedavar sheen mesakkechin bo — im yesh tachtav arba ammot, pesula.
Gemara kol hane lema li? tzericha: dei ashmeinan bayit shennifchat — mishshum dehane mechitzot levayit avidan. aval chatzer hammukkefet achsadra, dimchitzot lav leachsadra avidi — ema la, tzericha.
Vei ashmeinan hane tarte, mishshum dischachan sechach kasher hu, aval sukka gedola shehikkifuha bedavar sheen mesakkechin bo, dischachah sechach pasul hu — ema la, tzericha.
Amar rabba: ashkachtinhu lerabbanan deve rav deyatvi vekaamri: avir posel bishlosha, sechach pasul posel bearbaa.

Veamena lehu ana: avir defosel bishlosha mena lechu — ditnan: hirchik et hassikkuch min haddefanot shelosha tefachim — pesula. sechach pasul name la lifsoyl ella bearba ammot, ditnan: bayit shennifchat vesikkech al gabbav, im yesh ben hassikkuch lakkotel arba ammot — pesula!
Vaamaru li: bar minna dehahi, derav ushemuel amri tarvayyhu: mishshum dofen akumma nagu bah.

Veamena lehu ana: ma illu ikka sechach pasul pachot mearbaa vaavir pachot mishshelosha may? keshera. malleyeh beshappudin may — pesula, velo yehe avir happosel bishlosha kischach pasul happosel bearbaa!

Vaamaru li: i hachi, ledidach name deamrat sechach pasul posel bearba ammot, ma illu ikka sechach pasul pachot mearba ammot vaavir pachot mishshelosha, may? keshera. malleyeh beshappudin may — pesula. lo yehe avir happosel bishlosha kischach pasul happosel bearba ammot!
Veamena lehu ana: hay may? bishlama ledidi deamena arba ammot —
b: Mishshum shiura velav shiura hu. hay lav shiura hu, kevan dela shavu shiurayyhu lahadade — la mitztarfi.
Ella ledidchu deamritu shiur mishshum hafelaga — ma li ittaflag bischach pasul, ma li ittaflag bischach pasul vaavir.
Amar leh abbaye: ulemar name, nehi dela shavu shiurayyhu besukka gedola, besukka ketanna mi la shavu shiurayyhu?
Amar leh: hatam lav mishshum deshavu shiurayyhu lahadade hu, ella mishshum deleteh leshiura desukka hu.
Vechol hecha dela shavu shiurayyhu lahadade la mitztarfi? vehatnan: habbeged shelosha al shelosha, hassak arbaa al arbaa, haor chamishsha al chamishsha, mappatz shishsha al shishsha.
Vetane ala: habbeged vehassak, hassak vehaor, haor vehammappatz — mitztarfin ze im ze.
Hatam kidkatane tama, amar rabbi shimon: ma taam — hoil verauy letamme moshav. keditnan: hamekatztzea mikkullan tefach al tefach — tame.
Tefach al tefach lemay chaze? veamar rabbi shimon ben lakish mishshum rabbi yannay: hoil verauy (littelo) al gabbe hachamor.

Besura amri leha shemata behay lishshana. binhardea matnu: amar rav yehuda amar shemuel: sechach pasul baemtza — posel bearbaa. min hatztzad — posel bearba ammot. verav amar: ben min hatztzad ben baemtza — bearba ammot.

Tenan: natan aleha neser shehu rachav arbaa tefachim — keshera. bishlama lerav deamar ben baemtza ben min hatztzad bearba ammot, mishshum hachi keshera. ella lishmuel deamar baemtza bearbaa — ammay keshera? hacha bemay askinan — min hatztzad.
Ta shema: shene sedinin — mitztarfin. shene nesarim — en mitztarfin. rabbi meir omer: nesarim kisdinin.

Bishlama lehach lishshana deamar rav ben baemtza ben min hatztzad bearba ammot, may "mitztarfin" — mitztarfin learba ammot. ella lehach lishshana deamar rav baemtza bearbaa, hechi dame? i deit behu arbaa, lema lehu itzterofe? i delet behu arbaa, kanya bealma ninhu?
Leolam deit behu arbaa, umay "mitztarfin" — mitztarfin learba ammot min hatztzad.
Ta shema: sikkechah binsarin shel erez sheyyesh bahen arbaa — divre hakkol pesula. en bahen arbaa — rabbi meir posel verabbi yehuda machshir.

a: Umode rabbi meir sheim yesh ben neser leneser kimlo neser — shemmanniach pesal benehem ucheshera.
Bishlama leman deamar ben baemtza ben min hatztzad bearba ammot — mishshum hachi keshera. ella leman deamar baemtza bearbaa, ammay keshera?

Amar rav huna bereh derav yehoshua: hacha besukka dela havya ella shemone metzumetzamot askinan, veyahev neser ufesal veneser ufesal veneser ufesal mehay gisa, veneser ufesal veneser ufesal veneser ufesal mehay gisa,
Dehavu lehu shene fesalin baemtza, veikka hechsher sukka baemtza.
Amar abbaye: avir shelosha besukka gedola umiato, ben bekanim ben beshappudin — have miut. besukka ketanna, bekanim — have miut, beshappudin — la have miut.
Vehane mille min hatztzad. aval baemtza — peligi ba rav acha veravina, chad amar: yesh lavud baemtza, vechad amar: en lavud baemtza.

May tameh deman deamar yesh lavud baemtza — detanya: kora hayyotza mikkotel ze veenah nogaat bechotel acher, vechen shete korot, achat yotza mikkotel ze veachat yotza mikkotel acher veenan nogot zo bazo — pachot mishshelosha, eno tzarich lehavi kora acheret. shelosha — tzarich lehavi kora acheret.
Veiddach — shane korot derabbanan.
May tama deman deamar en lavud baemtza — ditnan: arubba shebbabbayit uvah poteach tefach, tumea babbayit — kullo tame, ma shekkeneged arubba — tahor. tumea keneged arubba — kol habbayit kullo tahor.
En baarubba poteach tefach, tumea babbayit — keneged arubba, tahor. tumea keneged arubba — kol habbayit kullo tahor.
Veiddach? shane hilchot tumea dehachi gemiri lehu.

Daresh rabbi yehuda bar ilay: bayit shennifchat vesikkech al gabbav — keshera. amar lefanav rabbi yishmael berabbi yose: rabbi, paresh, kach perash abba: arba ammot pesula, pachot mearba ammot keshera.
Daresh rabbi yehuda bar ilay: avruma sharya. amar lefanav rabbi yishmael berabbi yose: rabbi, paresh, kach amar abba: shel makom peloni — asura, shel makom peloni — mutteret.
Ki ha deamar abbaye: hay tzachanta devav nahara sharya. may tama? illema mishshum dirdifi mayya, vehay dag tame kevan delet leh chut hashshidra la matze kaem — veha ka chazenan dekae!

Ella mishshum dimlichi mayya, vehay dag tame, kevan delet leh kilfe la matze kae — veha ka chazenan dekae! ella: mishshum dela merabbe tinayyhu dag tame. amar ravina: vehaiddana, deshafchi nehar etan unehar gamda lehatam, asira.
Ittemar: sikkech al gabbe achsadra sheyyesh lah patztzimin — keshera. sheen lah patztzimin, abbaye amar: keshera, verava amar: pesula. abbaye amar keshera —
b: Amrinan pi tikra yored vesotem. rava amar pesula — la amrinan pi tikra yored vesotem.
Amar leh rava: abbaye, ledidach deamrat pi tikra yored vesotem, afillu hifchit dofen emtzai! amar leh: modena lach behahi, dehave leh kemavoy hamefullash.

Lema abbaye verava biflugeta derav ushemuel kamippalgi. deittemar: achsadra bevika, rav amar: muttar letaltel bechullo, deamrinan pi tikra yored vesotem. ushemuel amar: en metaltelin bah ella bearba ammot, dela amrinan pi tikra yored vesotem.
Allibba dishmuel, kulle alma la peligi.

a: Ki peligi allibba derav. abbaye kerav, verava amar lach: ad kan la amar rav hatam ella dimchitzot leachsadra hu daavidi, aval hacha delav lehachi avidi, la.
Tenan: vechen chatzer hammukkefet achsadra. veammay? nema pi tikra yored vesotem!
Targema rava allibba deabbaye: keshehishva et keruyo.

Besura matni leha shemata behay lishshana. befumebdita matni: sikkech al gabbe achsadra sheen lah patztzimin, divre hakkol pesula. yesh lah patztzimin, abbaye amar: keshera, rava amar: pesula. abbaye amar keshera — amrinan lavud. rava amar pesula — la amrinan lavud. vehilcheta kelishshana kamma.

Rav ashe ashkecheh lerav kahana deka mesakkech al gabbe achsadra sheen lah patztzimin. amar leh: la savar mar ha deamar rava: yesh lah patztzimin keshera, en lah patztzimin pesula! achvi leh, nire mibbifnim veshave mibbachutz.
I name, nire mibbachutz veshave mibbifnim.
Deittemar: nire mibbachutz veshave mibbifnim, niddon mishshum lechi. velechi hayeynu patztzimin.
Tana: pesal hayyotze min hassukka — niddon kassukka. may pesal hayyotze min hassukka? amar ulla: kanim hayyotzim laachore sukka.
Veha baenan shalosh defanot! bidikka. veha baenan hechsher sukka! bidikka. veha baenan tzillatah merubba mechammatah! bidikka.
I hachi may lememra? mahu detema: hoil ulegavvavy avidi ulevaray la avidi — ema la, ka mashma lan.
Rabba verav yosef amri tarvavyyhu: hacha bekanim hayyotzim lifnim min hassukka, umashcha veazla chada dofen bahadayyhu. mahu detema: ha let ba hechsher sukka, ka mashma lan.

Rabba bar bar chana amar rabbi yochanan: lo nitzrecha ella lesukka sherubbah tzillatah merubba mechammatah, umiutah chamatah merubba metzillatah. mahu detema: tippesal behach pureta, ka mashma lan. umay yotze — yotze mehechsher sukka.
Rabbi oshaya amar: lo nitzrecha ella lischach pasul pachot mishshelosha, besukka ketanna. umay "yotze" — yotze mittorat sukka.
Matkef la rav hoshaya: lo yehe ella avir, vaavir pachot mishshelosha tefachim besukka ketanna mi pasel?
Amar leh rabbi abba: ze mitztaref vishenim tachtav, veze mitztaref veen yeshenim tachtav.
Umi ikka midde deitzterofe mitztaref vehu atzmo eno kasher? amar rabbi yitzchak ben elyashiv: in,
b: Tit hannarok yochiach, shemmitztaref learbaim sea, vehattovel bo — lo alta lo tevila.
Mishna haose sukkato kemin tzerif, o shessemachah lechotel — rabbi eliezer posel mippene sheen lah gag, vachachamim machshirin.
Gemara tana: mode rabbi eliezer sheim higbihah min hakkarka tefach, o shehifligah min hakkotel tefach — shehi keshera.
May tamayyhu derabbanan? shippue ohalim keohalim damu.
Abbaye ashkecheh lerav yosef deka gane bechillat chatanim bassukka. amar leh: keman — kerabbi eliezer? shavkat rabbanan veavdat kerabbi eliezer!
Amar leh, barayyta ippecha tane: rabbi eliezer machshir vachachamim poslin. shavkat matnitin veavdat kevarayyta?
Amar leh: matnitin yechidaa hi. detanya: haose sukkato kemin tzerif o shessemachah lechotel, rabbi natan omer: rabbi eliezer posel mippene sheen lah gag, vachachamim machshirin.

Mishna machtzelet kanim gedola, asaah lishchiva — mekabbelet tumea, veen mesakkechin bah. lesikkuch — mesakkechin bah, veenah mekabbelet tumea. rabbi eliezer omer: achat ketanna veachat gedola, asaah lishchiva — mekabbelet tumea veen mesakkechin bah, lesikkuch — mesakkechin bah, veenah mekabbelet tumea.
Gemara ha gufa kashya. amrat: asaah lishchiva — mekabbelet tumea veen mesakkechin bah. tama daasaah lishchiva, ha setama — lesikkuch.
Vahadar tane: lesikkuch mesakkechin bah veenah mekabbelet tumea, tama daasaah lesikkuch, ha setama — lishchiva!
Ha la kashya: kan bigdola, kan biktanna.

(Bishlama lerabbanan la kashya, ella lerabbi eliezer kashya, ditnan:) rabbi eliezer omer: achat ketanna veachat gedola, asaah lishchiva — mekabbelet tumea veen mesakkechin bah. tama daasaah lishchiva, ha setama — lesikkuch.
Ema sefa: asaah lesikkuch — mesakkechin bah veenah mekabbelet tumea. tama daasaah lesikkuch, ha setama — lishchiva!
Ella amar rava: bigdola kulle alma la peligi distama lesikkuch. ki peligi biktanna. tanna kamma savar: setam ketanna lishchiva, verabbi eliezer savar: setam ketanna name lesikkuch.

a: Vehachi kaamar: machtzelet hakkanim gedola, asaah lishchiva — mekabbelet tumea, veen mesakkechin bah. tama daasaah lishchiva, ha setama — naasa kemi sheasaah lesikkuch, mesakkechin bah. (ketanna, asaah lesikkuch — mesakkechin bah. tama daasaah lesikkuch, ha setama — naasa kemi sheasaah lishchiva, veen mesakkechin bah). vaata rabbi eliezer lememar: achat ketanna veachat gedola, setama — keshera lesikkuch.
Amar leh abbaye: i hachi, rabbi eliezer omer: achat ketanna veachat gedola, "achat gedola veachat ketanna" mibbee leh!
Veod: ki peligi, bigdola hu difligi — verabbi eliezer lechumera. detanya: machtzelet hakkanim gedola mesakkechin bah. rabbi eliezer omer: im enah mekabbelet tumea — mesakkechin bah.
Ella amar rav pappa: biktanna kulle alma la peligi distama lishchiva. ki peligi bigdola, tanna kamma savar: setam gedola lesikkuch, verabbi eliezer savar: setam gedola name lishchiva.
Umay asaah lishchiva dekaamar — hachi kaamar: setam asiyyaytah name lishchiva, ad deaved lesikkuch.
Tanu rabbanan: machtzelet shel shifa veshel gemi, gedula — mesakkechin bah, ketanna — en mesakkechin bah. shel kanim veshel chilat, gedola — mesakkechin bah, aruga — en mesakkechin bah.
Rabbi yishmael berabbi yose omer mishshum aviv: achat zo veachat zo mesakkechin bah. vechen haya rabbi dosa omer kidvarav.
Tenan hatam: kol hachotzalot metammein teme met, divre rabbi dosa. vachachamim omrim: midras.
Midras in, teme met la? veha anan tenan: kol hammittamme midras — mittamme teme met. ema: af midras.
May chotzalot? amar rav avdimi bar hamedure: marzovle. may marzovle? amar rabbi abba: mazbele. rabbi shimon ben lakish omer: machtzalot mammash.

Veazda resh lakish letameh. deamar resh lakish: hareni kapparat rabbi chiyyay uvanav, shebbitchilla keshennishtakkecha tora miyyisrael — ala ezra mibbavel veyissedah. chazra venishtakkecha — ala hillel habbavli veyissedah. chazra venishtakkecha — alu rabbi chiyyay uvanav veyisseduha. vechen amar rabbi chiyyay uvanav: lo nechleku rabbi dosa vachachamim al machtzalot shel usha
b: Shehen temeot, veshel teverya shehen tehorot. al ma nechleku? al shear mekomot. mar savar: kevan delekka deyatev alayyhu — keditverya damyayn, umar savar: kevan demikkere veyatvi alayyhu — kidusha damyayn.
Amar mar: kol hachotzalot metammein teme met, divre rabbi dosa. vehatanya: vechen haya rabbi dosa omer kidvarav!
La kashya: ha deit leh gedanfa, ha delet leh gedanfa.
Metivi: chotzalot shel shaam veshel gemi veshel sak veshel sefira — mittamme teme met, divre rabbi dosa. vachachamim omrim: af midras.

Bishlama leman deamar marzovle. shel shaam veshel gemi — chazu lechinta defere. shel sak veshel sefira — chazu ligvalke vetzanne. ella leman deamar machtzalot mammash, bishlama shel sak veshel sefira — chazu lifrase venafvota, ella shel shaam veshel gemi lemay chazu? chazu lenazyata.

Ikka deamri: bishlama leman deamar machtzalot mammash, shel shaam veshel gemi — chazu lenazyata, shel sak veshel sefira — chazu lifrase venafvota. ella leman deamar marzovle, bishlama shel sak veshel sefira — chazu ligvalki vetzanne, ella shel shaam veshel gemi — lemay chazu? chazu lechinta defere.

Tanya, amar rabbi chananya: kesheyyaradti laggola matzati zaken echad, veamar li: mesakkechin bevudeya. ucheshebbati etzel rabbi yehoshua achi abba, hoda lidvarav. amar rav chisda: vehu delet leh gedanfa.
Amar ulla: hane budeyata divne machoza, ilmale kir shellahen, mesakkechin behu. tanya name hachi: mesakkechin bevudeya, veim yesh lahen kir — en mesakkechin bahen.
Hadaran alach sukka
Hayyashen tachat hammitta bassukka — lo yatza yede chovato. amar rabbi yehuda: nohagin hayinu shehayinu yeshenim tachat hammitta bifne hazzekenim, velo amru lanu davar.

Amar rabbi shimon, maase betavi avdo shel rabban gamliel shehaya yashen tachat hammitta, veamar lahen rabban gamliel lazzekenim: reitem tavi avdi, shehu talmid chacham veyodea sheavadim peturin min hassukka, lefichach yashen hu tachat hammitta. ulefi darkenu: lamadnu shehayyashen tachat hammitta lo yatza yede chovato.
Gemara veha lekka asara! targema shemuel bemitta asara.
Tenan hatam: echad chor shechararuhu mayim, o sheratzim, o sheachalattu melachat, vechen midbach avanim, vechen sevar shel korot — maahil al hattumea.
Rabbi yehuda omer: kol ohel sheeno asuy bide adam — eno ohel. may tama derabbi yehuda?

a: Yalef "ohel" "ohel" mimmishkan. ketiv hacha: "zot hattora adam ki yamut beohel", uchetiv hatam: "vayyifros et haohel al hammishkan", ma lehallan bide adam, af kan bide adam. verabbanan: "ohel" "ohel" ribba.

Vesavar rabbi yehuda kol ohel sheeno asuy bide adam eno ohel? ureminhu: chatzerot hayu benuyot birushalayim al gabbe hassela, vetachtehem chalal, mippene kever hattehom. umeviin nashim ubbarot veyoldot sham umegaddelot benehem sham lappara.

Umeviin shevavrim veal gabbehen delatot, vetinokot yoshvin al gabbehen vechosot shel even bidehem. higgiu lashshiloach, yardu letoch hammayim umilleum, vealu veyashvu lahem. rabbi yose omer: mimmekomo haya meshalshel umemalle, mippene kever hattehom.
Vetanya, rabbi yehuda omer: lo hayu meviin delatot, ella shevavrim. veha shevavrim, deohel sheeno asuy bide adam hu, vekatane, rabbi yehuda omer: lo hayu meviin delatot ella shevavrim!
Ki ata rav dimi, amar rabbi elazar: mode rabbi yehuda kimlo egrof. tanya name hachi: umode rabbi yehuda bishkifin uvinkike hasselaim.
Vahare delet, deyesh bah kamma egrofin, vekatane, rabbi yehuda omer: lo hayu meviin delatot ella shevavrim! amar abbaye, la hutzerchu lehavi delatot.
Rava amar: lo hayu meviin delatot kol ikkar, shemmippene sheddato shel tinok gassa alav, shemma yotzi rosho o echad meevarav, veyittame
b: Bekever hattehom.

Tanya kevoteh derava. rabbi yehuda omer: lo hayu meviin delatot kol ikkar, mippene sheddato shel tinok gassa alav, shemma yotzi rosho o echad meevarav veyittame bekever hattehom. ella meviin shevavrim hammitzrim shekkeresotehen rechavot, vehattinokot yoshvin al gabbehen, vechosot shel even bidehen. higgiu lashshiloach — yardu umilleum, vealu veyashvu lahen al gabbehen.

Vahare mitta, deyesh bah kamma egrofim, utenan, rabbi yehuda omer: nohagim hayinu shehayinu yeshenim tachat hammitta bifne hazzekenim! shane mitta, hoil ulegabbah asuya. shevavrim name legabban asuyim!

Ki ata ravin amar rabbi elazar: shane shevavrim hoil umeginnim al haroim bachamma mippene hachamma uvaggeshamim mippene haggeshamim. i hachi, mitta name — hoil umeginna al minalim vesandalim shettachteha!
Ella amar rava: shane shevavrim, hoil vaasuyim lehagen al bene meayim shellahen, shenneemar: "or uvasar talbisheni uvaatzamot vegidim tesochcheni".
Vei baet ema: rabbi yehuda letameh, deamar: sukka dirat keva baenan. vehave leh mitta dirat aray, vesukka ohel keva — vela ate ohel aray umevattel ohel keva.

Veha rabbi shimon deamar name — sukka dirat keva baenan, (ha) veate ohel aray umevattel ohel keva! (in) beha peligi, mar savar: ate ohel aray umevattel ohel keva, umar savar: la ate ohel aray umevattel ohel keva.

Amar rabbi shimon: maase betavi avdo. tanya, amar rabbi shimon: missichato shel rabban gamliel lamadnu shene devarim: lamadnu sheavadim peturim min hassukka, velamadnu shehayyashen tachat hammitta lo yatza yede chovato.

Velema: "middevarav shel rabban gamliel"? milleta aggav orcheh ka mashma lan, ki ha deamar rav acha bar adda, veamri la amar rav acha bar adda amar rav hamenuna amar rav: minnayin sheafillu sichat talmide chachamim, tzericha limmud — shenneemar: "vealehu lo yibbol".
Mishna hassomech sukkato bechare hammitta — keshera. rabbi yehuda omer: im enah yechola laamod bifne atzmah — pesula.
Gemara may tameh derabbi yehuda? peligi ba rabbi zera verabbi abba bar memel. chad amar: mippene sheen lah keva. vechad amar: mippene shemmaamidah bedavar hamekabbel tumea.

May benayyhu? kegon shennaatz shappudin shel barzel vesikkech alehem. leman deamar lefi sheen lah keva — hare yesh lah keva. uman deamar mippene shemmaamidah bedavar hamekabbel tumea — hare maamidah bedavar hamekabbel tumea.

Amar abbaye: lo shanu ella samach. aval sikkech al gav hammitta — keshera. may tama? leman deamar lefi sheen lah keva — hare yesh lah keva. leman deamar mippene shemmaamidah bedavar hamekabbel tumea — hare en maamidah bedavar hamekabbel tumea.

a: Mishna sukka hameduvelelet veshetztzillatah merubba mechammatah — keshera. hameubba kemin bayit, af al pi sheen hakkochavim nirin mittochah — keshera.
Gemara may meduvelelet? amar rav: sukka aniyyay. ushemuel amar: kane ole vekane yored.

Rav tane chada, ushemuel tane tarte. rav tane chada: sukka meduvelelet, may meduvelelet — meduledelet, shetztzillatah merubba mechammatah — keshera. ushemuel tane tarte: may meduvelelet — mevulebelet, vetarte katane: sukka mevulebelet keshera, vetzillatah merubba mechammatah — keshera.

Amar abbaye: lo shanu, ella sheen ben ze laze shelosha tefachim, aval yesh ben ze laze shelosha tefachim — pesula. amar rava: afillu yesh ben ze laze shelosha tefachim name la amaran, ella sheen begaggo tefach, aval yesh begaggo tefach — keshera. deamrinan: chavot remi.

Amar rava: mena amena la dechi it beh tefach amrinan chavot remi, vechi let beh la amrinan chavot remi? ditnan: korot habbayit vehaaliyyay sheen alehem maaziva, vehen mechuuonot tumea tachat achat mehen — tachteha tame.
Ben hattachtona laelyona — benehen tame, al gabbe haelyona — kenegdah ad larakia tame. hayu haelyonot keven hattachtonot, tumea tachtehen — tachat kullan tame. al gabbehen — kenegdan ad larakia tame.

Vetane ala: bamme devarim amurim — bizman sheyyesh bahen tefach uvenehen poteach tefach, aval en benehen poteach tefach, tumea tachat achat mehen — tachteha tame, benehen veal gabbehen — tahor. alma ki it beh tefach, amrinan chavot remi, vechi let beh tefach, la amrinan chavot remi! shema minna.
Yatev rav kahana vekaamar leha shemata. amar leh rav ashe lerav kahana: vechol hecha delet beh tefach la amrinan chavot remi?

Veha tanya: kora hayyotza mikkotel ze veenah nogaat bechotel ze, vechen shete korot achat yotza mikkotel ze veachat yotza mikkotel ze veenan nogot zo bazo, pachot mishshelosha — eno tzarich lehavi kora acheret, shelosha — tzarich lehavi kora acheret.
Rabban shimon ben gamliel omer:
b: Pachot mearbaa — en tzarich lehavi kora acheret, arbaa — tzarich lehavi kora acheret.

Vechen shete korot hammatimot, lo bazo kede lekabbel ariach velo bazo kede lekabbel ariach, im mekabbelot ariach lerochbo tefach — en tzarich lehavi kora acheret, veim lav — tzarich lehavi kora acheret,
Rabban shimon ben gamliel omer: im mekabbelot ariach leorko shelosha tefachim — en tzarich lehavi kora acheret. veim lav — tzarich lehavi kora acheret.

Hayu achat lemala veachat lematta, rabbi yose berabbi yehuda omer: roin haelyona keillu hi lematta, veet hattachtona keillu hi lemala. uvilvad shello tehe elyona lemala meesrim amma, vehattachtona lematta measara. ha ze veze betoch esrim — amrinan chavot remi af al gav delet beh tefach!

Amar leh, taretz veema hachi: uvilvad shello tehe elyona lemala meesrim, ella betoch esrim, vehattachtona semucha lah befachot mishshelosha. i name: bilvad shello tehe tachtona lematta measara, ella lemala measara, veelyona semucha lah befachot mishshelosha, aval shelosha, kevan delet beh tefach — la amrinan chavot remi.
Veshetztzillatah merubba mechammatah keshera. ha ki hadade — pesula. veha tenan beiddach pirkin: veshechamatah merubba mitztzillatah pesula, ha ki hadade — keshera!
La kashya: kan millemala, kan millematta. amar rav pappa, hayeynu deamri inashe: kezuza milleel, keistera milletachat.
Meubba kemin bayit. tanu rabbanan: hameubba kemin bayit, af al pi sheen hakkochavim nirin mittochah — keshera. en kochve chamma nirin mittochah — bet shammay poslin uvet hillel machshirin.
Mishna haose sukkato berosh haagala o berosh hassefina — keshera, veolin lah beyom tov. berosh hailan o al gabbe gamal — keshera, veen olin lah beyom tov.
Shetayim bailan veachat bide adam, o shetayim bide adam veachat bailan — keshera, veen olin lah beyom tov. shalosh bide adam veachat bailan — keshera, veolin lah beyom tov.

a: Ze hakkelal: kol sheyyinnatel hailan vichola laamod bifne atzmah — keshera veolin lah beyom tov.
Gemara manni matnitin — rabbi akiva hi. detanya: haose sukkato berosh hassefina — rabban gamliel posel, verabbi akiva machshir.
Maase berabban gamliel verabbi akiva shehayu bain bisfina, amad rabbi akiva veasa sukka berosh hassefina. lemachar nashva ruach vaakaratta. amar lo rabban gamliel: akiva! hechan sukkatcha?

Amar abbaye: dechulle alma, hecha deenah yechola laamod beruach metzuya deyabbasha — lo kelum hi. yechola laamod besheenah metzuya deyabbasha, kulle alma la peligi dichshera. ki peligi bedichola laamod beruach metzuya deyabbasha veenah yechola laamod (beruach sheenah metzuya deyabbasha). rabban gamliel savar: sukka dirat keva baenan, vechevan deenah yechola laamod beruach metzuya deyam — lo kelum hi. rabbi akiva savar: sukka dirat aray baenan, vechevan dichola laamod beruach metzuya deyabbasha — keshera.

O al gabbe gamal kulei. matnitin manni — rabbi meir hi. detanya: haose sukkato al gabbe behema — rabbi meir machshir, verabbi yehuda posel. may tameh derabbi yehuda? amar kera: "chag hassukkot taase lecha shivat yamim". sukka haruya leshiva — shemah sukka. sukka sheenah reuya leshiva — lo shemah sukka.
Verabbi meir, ha name — middeorayyta michze chazya, verabbanan hu digzaru ba.

Asaah livhema dofen lesukka — rabbi meir posel verabbi yehuda machshir. shehaya rabbi meir omer: kol davar sheyyesh bo ruach chayyim, en osin oto lo dofen lesukka, velo lechi lemavoy, velo passin leveraot, velo golel lekever. mishshum rabbi yose haggelili amru: af en kotvin alav gitte nashim.

May tameh derabbi meir? abbaye amar: shemma tamut. rabbi zera amar: shemma tivrach. befil kashur kulle alma la peligi, dei name mayet — yesh benivlato asara. ki peligi befil sheeno kashur. leman deamar shemma tamut — la chayyshinan. leman deamar gezera shemma tivrach — chayyshinan.

Leman deamar gezera shemma tamut, nechush shemma tivrach! ella: befil sheeno kashur, kulle alma la feligi. ki feligi bivhema keshura. leman deamar gezera shemma tamut — chayyshinan. uleman deamar gezera shemma tivrach — la chayyshinan.
Uman deamar gezera shemma tivrach, nechush shemma tamut? mita la shechicha. vehaikka ravvcha devene bene? deaved leh behutza vedafna.
Vedilma rava? dimticha beashle milleel. uleman deamar gezera shemma tamut name, ha meticha beashle milleel! zimnin demokem befachot mishshelosha samuch lassechach,
b: Vechevan demayyta — kavvtza velav addateh.
Umi amar abbaye rabbi meir chayesh lemita verabbi yehuda la chayesh? vehatnan: bat yisrael shennisset lechohen vehalach balah limdinat hayyam — ochelet bitruma, bechezkat shehu kayyaym.
Veramenan ala: hare ze gittich shaa achat kodem mitati — asura leechol bitruma miyyad!
Veamar abbaye, la kashya: ha rabbi meir dela chayesh lemita, ha rabbi yehuda dechayesh lemita.
Detanya: hallokeach yayin mibben hakkutim, omer: shene luggin sheani atid lehaferish hare hen teruma, asara maaser rishon, tisha maaser sheni, umechel veshote miyyad, divre rabbi meir.

a: Rabbi yehuda verabbi yose verabbi shimon osrin!
Efoch: rabbi meir chayesh lemita, verabbi yehuda la chayesh lemita, detanya: asaah labbehema dofen lassukka — rabbi meir posel, verabbi yehuda machshir.
Kashya derabbi meir adderabbi meir! amar lach rabbi meir: mita shechicha, bekiat hannod la shechicha, efshar demasar leh leshomer.
Kashya derabbi yehuda adderabbi yehuda!
Tama derabbi yehuda lav mishshum dechayesh livkiat nod, ella mishshum delet leh "berera".

Vela chayesh rabbi yehuda livkiat nod? veha middekatane sefa: amru lo lerabbi meir: i atta mode shemma yibbaka hannod venimtza ze shote tevalim lemafrea? vaamar lehu: lichsheyyibbaka. mikkelal dechayesh rabbi yehuda livkiat hannod!
Hatam rabbi yehuda hu dekaamar lerabbi meir: ledidi let li berera. ella ledidach deyesh berera — i atta mode deshemma yibbaka hannod? amar leh: lichsheyyibbaka.
Vela chayesh rabbi yehuda lemita? veha tenan, rabbi yehuda omer: af ishsha acheret matkinin lo, shemma tamut ishto. ha ittemar ala, amar rav huna bereh derav yehoshua: maala asu bechappara.

Ben leman deamar shemma tamut, ben leman deamar shemma tivrach, middeorayyta mechitza mealleya hi, verabbanan hu digzaru bah. ella meatta, lerabbi meir tetamme mishshum golel? allema tenan: rabbi yehuda metamme mishshum golel, verabbi meir metaher?

Ella amar rav acha bar yaakov: kasavar rabbi meir: kol mechitza sheomedet beruach — enah mechitza. ikka deamri, amar rav acha bar yaakov: kasavar rabbi meir kol mechitza sheenah asuya bide adam — enah mechitza.
May benayyhu? ikka benayyhu deokma benod tafuach. leman deamar mechitza omedet beruach enah mechitza — hare omedet beruach, leman deamar enah asuya bide adam —
b: Hare asuya bide adam.

Amar mar. mishshum rabbi yose haggelili amru: af en kotvin alav gitte nashim. may tameh derabbi yose haggelili? detanya: "sefer", en li ella sefer. minnayin lerabbot kol davar — talmud lomar: "vechatav lah" mikkol makom.
Im ken, ma talmud lomar "sefer"? lomar lach: ma sefer davar sheen bo ruach chayyim veeno ochel, af kol davar sheen bo ruach chayyim veeno ochel.
Verabbanan? i ketav "besefer", kidkaamrat. hasheta dichtiv "sefer" — lisfirat devarim bealma hu daata.

Verabbanan: hay "vechatav" may darshi beh? hahu mibbee lehu, bichtiva mitgareshet veenah mitgareshet bechesef. salka datach amena: hoil veittakkash yetzia lahavaya, ma havaya bakkesef — af yetzia bechesef, ka mashma lan.
Verabbi yose haggelili hay sevara mena leh? missefer keritut" nafka leh. sefer kortah, veen davar acher kortah.

Veiddach? hahu mibbee leh ledavar hakkoret beno levenah. kidtanya: hare ze gittich al menat shello tishti yayin, veal menat shello telchi levet avich leolam — en ze keritut, kol sheloshim yom — hare ze keritut.
Veiddach? mikkaret" "keritut" nafka. veiddach? "karet" "keritut" la darshi.
Mishna haose sukkato ben hailanot vehailanot defanot lah — keshera.
Gemara amar rav acha bar yaakov: kol mechitza sheenah yechola laamod beruach metzuya — enah mechitza.
Tenan: haose sukkato ben hailanot vehailanot defanot lah — keshera. veha kaazel veate! hacha bemay askinan — bekashin.
Vehaikka nofo! deaved leh behutza vedafna. i hachi, may lememra? mahu detema: nigzar dilma ate leishtammoshe beilan, ka mashma lan.
Ta shema: haya sham ilan o gader o mechitzat hakkanim — niddon mishshum deyomad! hatam name, mishshum deaved leh behutza vedafna.
Ta shema: ilan hammesech al haaretz, im en nofo gavoah min haaretz shelosha tefachim — metaltelin tachtav. ammay, ha ka azel veate? hatam name, deaved leh behutza vedafna.
I hachi, nittaltel bechulleh! allema amar rav huna bereh derav yehoshua: en metaltelin bo

a: Ella bet satayim!
Mishshum dehave dira shettashmisheha laavir, vechol dira shettashmisheha laavir en metaltelin bo ella satayim.

Ta shema: shavat betel shehu gavoah asara, vehu mearba ammot ad bet satayim, vechen beneka shehu amok asara, vehu mearba ammot ad bet satayim, vechen kama ketzura veshibbolot makkifot otah — mehallech et kullah vechutza lah alpayim amma. af al gav dekaazel veate! hatam name, deaved leh behutza vedafna.
Mishna sheluche mitzva — peturin min hassukka. cholin umeshammeshehen — peturin min hassukka. ochlin veshotin aray chutz lassukka.

Gemara mena hane mille? tanu rabbanan: "beshivtecha bevetecha" — perat leosek bemitzva, "uvelechtecha vadderech" — perat lechatan. mikkan amru: hakkones et habbetula — patur, veet haalmana — chayyayv.
May mashma? amar rav huna: kederech. ma derech reshut, af kol reshut, leappoke hay divmitzva asuk.

Mi la askinan dekaazel lidvar mitzva, veka amar rachamana likre! im ken lema kera "beshevet uvelechet", may "beshivtecha" "uvelechtecha" — belechet didach hu demichayyeyvat, ha belechet demitzva — petirat.
I hachi, afillu kones et haalmana name? kones et habbetula terid, kones almana la terid.

Vechol hecha ditrid, hachi name defatur?! ella meatta, tava sefinato bayyam — ditrid, hachi name defatur?! vechi tema hachi name, vehaamar rabbi abba bar zavda amar rav: avel chayyayv bechol hammitzvot haamurot battora chutz min hattefillin, shehare neemar bahen "peer"!
Hacha terid tirda demitzva, hatam terid tirda dirshut.

Vehaosek bemitzva patur min hammitzva mehacha nafka? mehatam nafka, detanya: "vayhi anashim asher hayu temeim lenefesh adam vegomer" — otam anashim mi hayu? nose arono shel yosef hayu, divre rabbi yose haggelili.
b: Rabbi akiva omer: mishael veeltzafan hayu, shehayu oskin benadav vaavihu. rabbi yitzchak omer: im nose arono shel yosef hayu, kevar hayu yecholin littaher. im mishael veeltzafan hayu, yecholin hayu littaher.
Ella, oskin bemet mitzva hayu shechal shevii shellahen lihyot beerev pesach, shenneemar: "velo yachlu laasot happesach bayyom hahu", beyom hahu en yecholin laasot, ha lemachar — yecholin laasot!

Tzericha, dei ashmeinan hatam — mishshum dela meta zeman chiyyuva defesach, aval hacha, dimta zeman keriat shema — ema la, tzericha. vei ashmeinan hacha — mishshum delekka karet, aval hatam, deikka karet — ema la, tzericha.

Gufa, amar rabbi abba bar zavda amar rav: avel chayyayv bechol mitzvot haamurot battora chutz mittefillin, shehare neemar bahen "peer". middaamar leh rachamana lichezkel "peercha chavosh alecha vegomer" — at hu demichayyeyvat, aval kulle alma petiri.
Vehane mille beyom rishon, dichtiv: "veacharitah keyom mar".

Veamar rabbi abba bar zavda amar rav: avel chayyayv bassukka. peshita? mahu detema: hoil veamar rabbi abba bar zavda amar rav: mitztaer patur min hassukka — hay name mitztaer hu, kamashma lan: hane mille tzaara demimmela, aval hacha, ihu hu deka metzaar nafsheh, ibbei leh leyattove dateh.

Veamar rabbi abba bar zavda amar rav: chatan vehashshoshvinin vechol bene hachuppa — peturin min hassukka kol shiva. may tama? mishshum devau lemichde. velechlu bassukka velichdo bassukka! en simcha ella bachuppa. velechlu bassukka velichdo bachuppa! en simcha ella bimkom seuda.

Velebedu chuppa bassukka? abbaye amar: mishshum yichud. verava amar: mishshum tzaar chatan. may benayyhu? ikka benayyhu dishchichi inashe denafki veayyli lehatam. leman deamar mishshum yichud — lekka. leman deamar mishshum tzaar chatan — ikka.
Amar rabbi zera: ana achali bassukka vachaday bachuppa, vechol shekken dechade libbay deka avedna tarte.
Tanu rabbanan: chatan vehashshoshvinin vechol bene chuppa, peturin min hattefilla umin hattefillin, vechayyayvin bikriat shema.

a: Mishshum rabbi shela amru: chatan patur, vehashshoshvinin vechol bene hachuppa chayyayvin.

Tanya, amar rabbi chananya ben akavya: kotve sefarim tefillin umezuzot, hen vetaggarehen vetaggare taggarehen vechol haoskin bimlechet shamayim, leetoye mochre techelet — peturin mikkeriat shema umin hattefilla umin hattefillin umikkol mitzvot haamurot battora, lekayyem divre rabbi yose haggelili, shehaya rabbi yose haggelili omer: haosek bemitzva patur min hammitzva.

Tanu rabbanan: holche derachim bayyom — peturin min hassukka bayyom, vechayyayvin ballayla. holche derachim ballayla — peturin min hassukka ballayla vechayyayvin bayyom. holche derachim bayyom uvallayla — peturin min hassukka ben bayyom uven ballayla. holchin lidvar mitzva — peturin ben bayyom uven ballayla. ki ha derav chisda verabba bar rav huna ki havo ayyli beshabbeta derigla leve resh galuta, havo ganu arakta desura, amri: anan sheluche mitzva anan ufeturin.

Tanu rabbanan: shomre hair bayyom — peturin min hassukka bayyom, vechayyayvin ballayla. shomre hair ballayla — peturin min hassukka ballayla, vechayyayvin bayyom. shomre hair ben bayyom uven ballayla — peturim min hassukka ben bayyom uven ballayla.
Shomre gannot ufardesim — peturin ben bayyom uven ballayla. velibedu sukka hatam velittevu? abbaye amar: "teshvu" — keen taduru.
Rava amar: pirtza kora laggannav. may benayyhu? ikka benayyhu deka menattar karya defere.

Cholim umeshammeshehem. tanu rabbanan: chole sheamru, lo chole sheyyesh bo sakkana, ella afillu chole sheen bo sakkana. afillu chash beenav, vaafillu chash berosho. amar rabban shimon ben gamliel: paam achat chashti beene bekesari, vehittir rabbi yose beribbi lishan ani umeshammeshay chutz lassukka.
Rav shera lerav acha bardela lemigne bechilleta bassukka — mishshum bake. rava shera leh lerabbi acha bar adda lemigne bar mimmetallalta — mishshum sircha degargishta.

Rava letameh, deamar rava: mitztaer — patur min hassukka. veha anan tenan: cholin umeshammeshehem peturim min hassukka. chole in, mitztaar la! amri: chole — hu umeshammeshav peturim, mitztaer — hu patur, meshammeshav la.

Ochlim achilat aray chutz lassukka. vechamma achilat aray? amar rav yosef: tarte o telat bee. amar leh abbaye: veha zimnin saggiin saggi leh leinish behachi, vehave leh seudat keva! ella amar abbaye: kidtaem bar be rav veayel lechalla.
Tanu rabbanan: ochlin achilat aray chutz lassukka, veen yeshenim shenat aray chutz lassukka. may tama? amar rav ashe: gezera shemma yeradem.
Amar leh abbaye, ella ha detanya: yashen adam shenat aray bitfillin, aval lo shenat keva, lechush shemma yeradem! amar rav yosef bereh derav illay: bemoser shenato laacherim.
Matkef leh rav mesharsheya: arvaych arva tzerich! ella amar rabba bar bar chana amar rabbi yochanan: bemanniach rosho ben birkav askinan. rava amar: en keva lashshena.

Tane chada: yashen adam bitfillin shenat aray aval lo shenat keva, vetanya iddach: ben keva ben aray. vetanya iddach: lo keva velo aray. la kashya: ha — denaket lehu bideh. ha — demannechi beresheh. ha — defares sudara illaveh.
Vechamma shenat aray? tane rame bar yechezkel: kede hilluch mea amma. tanya name hachi: hayyashen bitfillin veroe keri — ochez bartzua
b: Veeno ochez bakketzitza, divre rabbi yaakov. vachachamim omrim: yashen adam bitfillin shenat aray, aval lo shenat keva. vechamma shenat aray — kede hilluch mea amma.
Amar rav: asur laadam lishan bayyom yoter mishshenat hassus. vechamma shenat hassus — shittin nishme.
Amar abbaye: shinteh demar kidrav, uderav kidrabbi, uderabbi kiddavid, udedavid kidsuseya, udesuseya shittin nishme.
Abbaye hava nayem kedimayyel mippumebdita leve chubbe. kare aleh rav yosef: "ad matay atzel tishkav matay takum mishshenatecha".

Tanu rabbanan: hannichnas lishan bayyom, ratza — choletz, ratza — manniach. ballayla — choletz veeno manniach, divre rabbi natan. rabbi yose omer: hayyeladim, leolam choltzin veenan mannichin, mippene shergilin betumea.
Lema kasavar rabbi yose baal keri asur lehanniach tefillin? amar abbaye: biladim uneshotehen immahen askinan, shemma yavou lide hergel davar.
Tanu rabbanan: shachach veshimmesh mittato bitfillin — eno ochez lo bartzua velo bakketzitza ad sheyyittol yadav veyittelem, mippene shehayyadayim askaniyyot hen.
Mishna maase veheviu lo lerabban yochanan ben zakkay litom et hattavshil, ulerabban gamliel shene kotavot udeli shel mayim. veamru: haalum lassukka.
Ucheshennatnu lo lerabbi tzadok ochel pachot mikkevetza, netalo bammappa, vaachalo chutz lassukka, velo berach acharav.

Gemara maase listor?! chassore mechassera vehachi katane: im ba lehachemir al atzmo — machmir, velet beh mishshum yuhara. umaase name veheviu lo lerabban yochanan ben zakkay litom et hattavshil, ulerabban gamliel shete chotavot udeli shel mayim,

a: Veamru: haalum lassukka.

Ucheshennatnu lo lerabbi tzadok ochel pachot mikkevetza, netalo bemappa vaachalo chutz lassukka velo berach acharav. ha kevetza, bae sukka. lema tehve teyuveteh derav yosef veabbaye! dilma pachot mikkevetza netila uveracha la bae, ha kevetza bae netila uveracha.
Mishna rabbi eliezer omer: arba esre seudot chayyayv adam leechol bassukka, achat beyom veachat ballayla. vachachamim omrim: en laddavar kitzva, chutz millele yom tov rishon shel chag bilvad.

Veod amar rabbi eliezer: mi shello achal [lele] yom tov harishon — yashlim lele yom tov haacharon shel chag. vachachamim omrim: en laddavar tashlumin, veal ze neemar: "meuvvat lo yuchal litkon vechesron lo yuchal lehimmanot".
Gemara may tameh derabbi eliezer? "teshvu" keen taduru. ma dira — achat bayyom veachat ballayla, af sukka — achat beyom veachat ballayla.
Verabbanan? kedira. ma dira — i bae achel i bae la achel, af sukka name — i bae achel i bae la achel.
I hachi afillu lele yom tov rishon name!

Amar rabbi yochanan mishshum rabbi shimon ben yehotzadak: neemar kan "chamishsha asar", veneemar "chamishsha asar" bechag hammatztzot. ma lehallan — layla harishon chova, mikkan veelach reshut, af kan — layla harishon chova, mikkan veelach reshut.
Vehatam menalan? amar kera: "baerev tochlu matztzot", hakkatuv kevao chova.
Veod amar rabbi eliezer: veha amar rabbi eliezer arba esre seudot chayyayv adam leechol bassukka, achat bayyom veachat ballayla! amar bera amar rabbi amme: chazar bo rabbi eliezer.
Mashlim bemay? ilema berifta, seuda deyomeh ka achel. ella, may yashlim — yashlim bemine targima. tanya name hachi: im hishlim bemine targima — yatza.

Shaal appotroppos shel agrippas hammelech et rabbi eliezer: kegon ani, sheeni ragil leechol ella seuda achat bayyom, mahu sheochal seuda achat veeppater? amar lo: bechol yom veyom atta mamshich kamma parperaot lichvod atzmecha, veachshav i atta mamshich parperet achat lichvod konecha?

Veod shealo: kegon ani sheyyesh li shete nashim, achat bitverya veachat betzippori, veyesh li shete sukkot achat bitverya veachat betzippori, mahu sheetze missukka lesukka veeppater? amar lo: lo! sheani omer: kol hayyotze missukka lesukka bittel mitzvatah shel rishona.
Tanya rabbi eliezer omer:
b: En yotzin missukka lesukka, veen osin sukka bechullo shel moed. vachachamim omrim: yotzin missukka lesukka, veosin sukka bechullo shel moed. veshavin, sheim nafla, shechozer uvonah bechullo shel moed.
May tama derabbi eliezer? amar kera: "chag hassukkot taase lecha shivat yamim", ase sukka haruya leshiva. verabbanan? hachi kaamar rachamana: ase sukka bechag.
Veshavin sheim nafla, shechozer uvone otah bechullo shel moed. peshita? mahu detema hay achariti hi veenah leshiva, ka mashma lan.

Tanya rabbi eliezer omer: keshem sheen adam yotze yede chovato bayyom tov harishon shel chag belulavo shel chavero, dichtiv: "ulekachtem lachem bayyom harishon peri etz hadar kappot temarim" — mishshellachem, kach en adam yotze yede chovato besukkato shel chavero, dichtiv: "chag hassukkot taase lecha shivat yamim" — mishshellecha.

Vachachamim omrim: af al pi sheamru en adam yotze yede chovato beyom tov harishon belulavo shel chavero, aval yotze yede chovato besukkato shel chavero, dichtiv: "kol haezrach beyisrael yeshvu bassukkot", melammed shekkol yisrael reuyim leshev besukka achat.
Verabbanan, hay "lecha", may darshi beh? mibbee leh lemaote gezula, aval sheula ketiv: "kol haezrach".
Verabbi eliezer, hay "kol haezrach" may aved leh? mibbee leh leger shennitgayyer bentayim vekatan shennitgaddel bentayim. verabbanan? kevan sheamru: osin sukka bechullo shel moed, la itzterich kera.

Tanu rabbanan: maase berabbi ilay shehalach lehakebil pene rabbi eliezer rabbo belod baregel. amar lo: ilay! encha mishshovte haregel. shehaya rabbi eliezer omer: meshabbeach ani et haatzlanin, sheen yotzin mibbattehen baregel, dichtiv: "vesamachta atta uvetecha".

Ini?! vehaamar rabbi yitzchak: minnayin shechayyayv lehakebil pene rabbo baregel, shenneemar: "maddua at holechet elav hayyom lo chodesh velo shabbat", mikkelal divchodesh veshabbat michayyayv inish leakbole appe rabbeh! la kashya: ha — deazel veate beyomeh, ha — deazel vela ate beyomeh.

Tanu rabbanan: maase berabbi eliezer sheshshavat baggalil haelyon besukkato shel yochanan berabbi ilay bekesari, veamri la bekesaryon, vehiggia chamma lassukka. amar lo: mahu sheefros aleha sadin? amar lo: en lecha kol shevet veshevet miyyisrael shello heemid mimmennu shofet.

Higgia chamma lachatzi hassukka, amar lo: mahu sheefros aleha sadin? amar lo: en lecha kol shevet veshevet miyyisrael shello yatzu mimmennu neviim. shevet yehuda uvinyamin heemidu melachim al pi neviim. higgia chamma lemargelotav shel rabbi eliezer, natal yochanan sadin uferas aleha, hifshil rabbi eliezer tallito laachorav veyatza. lo mippene shehifligo bidvarim, ella mippene shello amar davar shello shama mippi rabbo leolam.
Hechi aved hachi? vehaamar rabbi eliezer: en yotzin missukka lesukka! regel acher havay.
Vehaamar rabbi eliezer: meshabbeach ani et haatzlanin sheen yotzin mibbattehen baregel! shabbat havay.
Vetifshot leh middideh ditnan: pekak hachallon, rabbi eliezer omer: bizman shekkashur vetaluy — pokkin bo, veim lav — en pokkin bo. vachachamim omrim: ben kach uven kach pokkin.

a: Hatam hu dimvattel, aval hacha dela mevattel — la.

Tanu rabbanan: maase berabbi eliezer sheshshavat baggalil haelyon, ushealuhu sheloshim halachot behilchot sukka, shetem esre amar lahem: shamati, shemone esre amar lahem: lo shamati. rabbi yose berabbi yehuda omer, chilluf haddevarim: shemone esre amar lahem: shamati, shetem esre amar lahem: lo shamati.

Amru lo: kol devarecha enan ella mippi hashshemua! amar lahem: hizkaktuni lomar davar shello shamati mippi rabbotay. miyyamay lo kedamani adam bevet hammidrash, velo yashanti bevet hammidrash lo shenat keva velo shenat aray, velo hinnachti adam bevet hammidrash veyatzati, velo sachti sichat chullin, velo amarti davar shello shamati mippi rabbi meolam.

Amru alav al rabban yochanan ben zakkay: miyyamav lo sach sichat chullin, velo halach arba ammot bela tora uvelo tefillin, velo kedamo adam bevet hammidrash, velo yashan bevet hammidrash lo shenat keva velo shenat aray, velo hirher bimvoot hametunnafot, velo hinniach adam bevet hammidrash veyatza, velo metzao adam yoshev vedomem ella yoshev veshone, velo patach adam delet letalmidav, ella hu beatzmo, velo amar davar shello shama mippi rabbo meolam, velo amar: higgia et laamod mibbet hammidrash, chutz mearve fesachim, vearve yom hakkippurim. vechen haya rabbi eliezer talmido noheg acharav.

Tanu rabbanan: shemonim talmidim hayu lo lehillel hazzaken. sheloshim mehen reuyim shettishre alehen shechina kemoshe rabbenu, usheloshim mehen reuyim shettaamod lahem chamma kihoshua bin nun. esrim benonim. gadol shebbechullan — yonatan ben uzziel, katan shebbechullan — rabban yochanan ben zakkay.

Amru alav al rabban yochanan ben zakkay shello hinniach mikra umishna, gemara halachot veaggadot; dikduke tora vedikidduke sofrim; kallim vachamurim ugezerot shavot; tekufot vegimatriyyaot; sichat malache hashsharet vesichat shedim vesichat dekalim; mishlot kovsin, mishlot shualim; davar gadol vedavar katan.

Davar gadol — maase merkava. davar katan — havayot deabbaye verava. lekayyem ma shenneemar: "lehanechil ohavay yesh veotzrotehem amalle". vechi meachar shekkatan shebbechullan kach, gadol shebbechullan al achat kamma vechamma. amru alav al yonatan ben uzziel, beshaa sheyyoshev veosek battora — kol of shepporeach alav miyyad nisraf.

Mishna mi shehaya rosho verubbo bassukka veshulechano betoch habbayit — bet shammay poslin uvet hillel machshirin. amru lahem bet hillel levet shammay: lo kach haya maase shehalchu zikne bet shammay vezikne bet hillel levakker et rabbi yochanan ben hachoranit, umetzauhu shehaya yoshev rosho verubbo bassukka veshulechano betoch habbayit, velo amru lo davar. amru lahem bet shammay: mishsham reaya?! af hem amru lo: im ken hayita noheg, lo kiyyaymta mitzvat sukka miyyamecha.

Nashim vaavadim uketannim peturin min hassukka. katan sheeno tzarich leimmo — chayyayv besukka. maase veyalda kallato shel shammay hazzaken, ufichet et hammaaziva vesikkech al gabbe hammitta bishvil katan.
Gemara mena hane mille? detanu rabbanan: "ezrach" — ze ezrach, "haezrach" — lehotzi et hannashim, "kol" — lerabbot et hakketannim.

Amar mar: "haezrach" — lehotzi et hannashim. lememra deezrach", ben nashim ben gavre mashma? vehatanya: "haezrach" — lerabbot et hannashim haezrachiyyot, shechayyayvot beinnuy. alma "ezrach" — gavre mashma! amar rabba: hilcheta ninhu veasmechinhu rabbanan akkerae.
He kera vehe hilcheta? vetu: kera lema li, hilcheta lema li? ha sukka mitzvat ase shehazzeman gerama, vechol mitzvat ase shehazzeman gerama nashim peturot.
Yom hakkippurim, midderav yehuda amar rav nafka. deamar rav yehuda amar rav, vechen tana deve rabbi yishmael amar kera: "ish o ishsha",
b: Hishva hakkatuv ishsha leish lechol onashin shebbattora. amar abbaye: leolam sukka hilcheta, veitzterich. salka datach amena "teshvu" — keen taduru, ma dira — ish veishto, af sukka — ish veishto, ka mashma lan.
Rava amar: itzterich, salka datach amena yalef "chamishsha asar" "chamishsha asar" mechag hammatztzot. ma lehallan — nashim chayyayvot, af kan — nashim chayyayvot. ka mashma lan.
Vehasheta deamrat sukka hilcheta, kara lema li? lerabbot et haggerim. salka datach amena: "haezrach beyisrael" amar rachamana — velo et haggerim, ka mashma lan.

Yom hakkippurim midderav yehuda amar rav nafka. lo nitzrecha ella letosefet innuy. salka datach amena: hoil umiet rachamana letosefet innuy meonesh umeazhara, lo nitchayyeyvu nashim kelal, ka mashma lan.

Amar mar: "kol" lerabbot et hakketannim. vehatnan: nashim vaavadim uketannim peturin min hassukka! la kashya kan — bekatan shehiggia lechinnuch, kan — bekatan shello higgia lechinnuch. katan shehiggia lechinnuch midderabbanan hu! midderabbanan, ukera — asmachta bealma hu.

Katan sheeno tzarich leimmo kulei. hechi dame katan sheeno tzarich leimmo? amri deve rabbi yannay: kol shennifne veen immo mekannachto. rabbi (shimon) omer: kol shenneor mishshenato veeno kore "imma, [imma]!" gedolim name karu? ella: (ema) kol shenneor veeno kore: "imma, imma!".

Maase veyalda kallato kulei. maase listor? chassore mechassera vehachi katane: veshammay machmir, umaase name veyalda kallato shel shammay hazzaken, ufichet et hammaaziva vesikkech al hammitta bishvil hakkatan.

Mishna kol shivat hayyamim adam ose sukkato keva, uveto aray. yardu geshamim, meematay muttar lefannot — mishshettisrach hammikpa. mashlu mashal lema haddavar dome — leeved shebba limzog kos lerabbo, veshafach lo kiton al panav.

Gemara tanu rabbanan: kol shivat hayyamim adam ose sukkato keva uveto aray, ketzad? hayu lo kelim naim maalan lassukka, matztzaot naot — maalan lassukka, ochel veshote umetayyel bassukka. mena hane mille? detanu rabbanan: "teshvu" — keen taduru, mikkan amru: kol shivat hayyamim ose adam sukkato keva uveto aray. ketzad? hayu lo kelim naim — maalan lassukka, matztzaot naot — maalan lassukka, ochel veshote umetayyel bassukka umeshannen bassukka.
Ini?! vehaamar rava: mikra umitne bimtallalta, vetannoye bar mimmetallalta! la kashya: ha — bemigras, ha — beayyone.

a: Ki ha (derabba) bar chama ki havo kayymi mikkammeh derav chisda marhati bigmara bahade hadade, vahadar meayyeyni bisvara.

Amar rava: mane mishteya — bimtallalta, mane mechla — bar mimmetallalta. chatzba veshachel — bar mimmetallalta, usheraga — bimtallalta. veamri la: bar mimmetallalta. vela peligi: ha — besukka gedola, ha — besukka ketanna.
Yardu geshamim. tana: mishshettisrach hammikpa shel gerisin.

Abbaye hava ka yatev kammeh derav yosef bimtallalta, neshav zika veka mayyte tzivvata. amar lehu rav yosef: pannu li manay mehacha. amar leh abbaye, veha tenan: mishshettisrach hammikpa! amar leh: ledidi, kevan daanina datay — kemi shettisrach hammikpa dame li.

Tanu rabbanan: haya ochel bassukka veyardu geshamim veyarad — en matrichin oto laalot ad sheyyigmor seuddato. haya yashen tachat hassukka veyardu geshamim veyarad — en matrichin oto laalot ad sheyyeor.
Ibbaya lehu: ad sheyyeor o ad sheyyeor? ta shema: ad sheyyeor veyaale ammud hashshachar. tarte?! ella ema: ad sheyyeor veyaale ammud hashshachar.
Mashal lema haddavar dome. ibbaya lehu: mi shafach lemi? ta shema detanya: shafach lo rabbo kiton al panav, veamar lo: i efshi beshimmushecha.

Tanu rabbanan: bizman shehachamma loka — siman ra lechol haolam kullo. mashal lema haddavar dome? lemelech basar vadam sheasa seudda laavadav vehinniach panas lifnehem, kaas alehem veamar leavdo: tol panas mippenehem vehoshivem bachoshech.

Tanya rabbi meir omer: kol zeman shemmeorot lokin — siman ra lesonehem shel yisrael, mippene shemmelummadin bemakkotehen. mashal lesofer shebba levet hassefer uretzua beyado, mi doeg — mi sheragil lilkot bechol yom vayom hu doeg.

Tanu rabbanan: bizman shehachamma loka — siman ra laggoyim. levana loka — siman ra lesonehem shel yisrael. mippene sheyyisrael monin lallevana, vegoyim lachamma. loka bammizrach — siman ra leyoshve mizrach. bammaarav — siman ra leyoshve maarav. beemtza harakia — siman ra lechol haolam kullo.

Panav domin ledam — cherev ba laolam. lesak — chitztze raav bain laolam. lazo velazo — cherev vechitztze raav bain laolam. laka bichnisato — pureanut shoha lavo. bitziato — memaheret lavo. veyesh omrim chilluf haddevarim.

Veen lecha kol umma veummah shelloka, sheen eloheha loke immah, shenneemar: "uvechol elohe mitzrayim eese shefatim". uvizman sheyyisrael osin retzono shel makom en mityarin mikkol ellu, shenneemar: "ko amar Adonai el derech haggoyim al tilmadu umeotot hashshamayim al techattu ki yechattu haggoyim mehemma" — goyim yechattu, veen yisrael yechattu.

Tanu rabbanan: bishvil arbaa devarim chamma loka: al av bet din shemmet veeno nispad kahalacha, veal naara hameorasa shetztzaaka bair veen moshia lah, veal mishkav zechur, veal shene achin shennishpach daman keechad.
Uvishvil arbaa devarim meorot lokin: al kotve felaster, veal meide edut sheker, veal megaddele behema dakka beeretz yisrael, veal kotztze ilanot tovot.
Uvishvil arbaa devarim nichse baale vattim nimsarin lammalchut: al mashhe shetarot peruim, veal malve beribbit,
b: Veal shehaya sippek beyadam limchot velo michu, veal shepposkim tzedaka barabbim veenan notnin.

Amar rav: bishvil arbaa devarim nichse baale battim yotzin letimyon: al kovshe sechar sachir, veal oshke sechar sachir, veal shepporkin ol meal tzavverehen venotnin al chavrehen, veal gassut haruach. vegassut haruach — keneged kullan. aval baanavim ketiv: "vaanavim yirshu aretz vehitannegu al rov shalom".
Hadaran alach hayyashen

Lulav haggazul vehayyavesh — pasul. shel ashera veshel ir hanniddachat — pasul. niktam rosho, nifretzu alav — pasul. nifredu alav — kasher. rabbi yehuda omer: yaagdennu milmala. tzine har habbarzel — kesherot. lulav sheyyesh bo shelosha tefachim kede lenanea bo — kasher.
Gemara ka fasek vetane, la shena beyom tov rishon, vela shena beyom tov sheni.
Bishlama yavesh — "hadar" baenan, velekka. ella gazul, bishlama yom tov rishon, dichtiv: "lachem" — mishshellachem. ella beyom tov sheni ammay la?
Amar rabbi yochanan mishshum rabbi shimon ben yochay:

a: Mishshum dehave leh mitzva habbaa baavera, shenneemar: "vahavetem gazul veet happisseach veet hachole". gazul dumeya defisseach, ma pisseach let leh takkanta — af gazul let leh takkanta, la shena lifne yeush vela shena leachar yeush.
Bishlama lifne yeush — "adam ki yakriv mikkem" amar rachamana, velav dideh hu. ella leachar yeush — ha kanyeh beyeush! ella lav, mishshum dehave leh mitzva habbaa baavera.

Veamar rabbi yochanan mishshum rabbi shimon ben yochay: may dichtiv: "ki ani Adonai ohev mishpat sone gazel beola" — mashal lemelech basar vadam shehaya over al bet hammeches, amar laavadav: tenu meches lammochsim. amru lo: vahalo kol hammeches kullo shellecha hu? amar lahem: mimmenni yilmedu kol ovre derachim velo yavrichu atzman min hammeches. af hakkadosh baruch hu amar: "ani Adonai sone gazel beola", mimmenni yilmedu banay veyavrichu atzman min haggazel.
Ittemar name, amar rabbi amme: yavesh pasul mippene sheen hadar, gazul pasul mishshum dehave leh mitzva habbaa baavera.
Ufeliga derabbi yitzchak. deamar rabbi yitzchak bar nachmani amar shemuel: lo shanu, ella beyom tov rishon, aval beyom tov sheni, mittoch sheyyotze beshaul — yotze name begazul.

Metiv rav nachman bar yitzchak: lulav haggazul vehayyavesh — pasul, ha shaul — kasher. emat? illema beyom tov rishon, ha ketiv: "lachem" — mishshellachem, vehay lav dideh hu. ella lav, beyom tov sheni, vekatane gazul — pasul!
(Rava amar:) leolam beyom tov rishon, vela mibbaya kaamar: la mibbaya shaul delav dideh hu, aval gazul, ema: setam gezela yeush bealim hu, uchedideh dame, ka mashma lan.
Amar lehu rav huna lehanhu avavnkare: ki zavnitu asa miggoyim — la tigzezu attun, ella ligzezu inhu veyahavu lechu. may tama — setam goyim gazlane arata ninhu
b: Vekarka enah nigzelet. hilkach ligzezu inhu, ki hechi delihvo yeush bealim bidayyhu didhu veshinnuy harshut bidayychu.
Sof sof ki gazzu avavnkare, leheve yeush bealim bidayyhu veshinnuy harshut bidan! la tzericha, behoshana daavavnkare gufayyhu.
Velikneyu beshinnuy maase! ka savar lulav en tzarich eged.
Veim timtze lomar lulav tzarich eged, shinnuy hachozer livriyyayto hu, veshinnuy hachozer livriyyayto — la shemeh shinnuy.
Velikneyu beshinnuy hashshem, demeikkara hava leh assa vehasheta
